source_quality_scale.4: official primary source or official catalogue; current release, legal duty, operational method, reporting contract or safety control verified
source_quality_scale.3: official source with a material provisional, retrospective, case-specific, dynamic-state, guidance-currency or scope caveat

quality_guards: Road-casualty figures for 2025 remain provisional until final validation and publication.
Known missing collisions and under-reporting of non-fatal casualties are retained as explicit limits.
Rail harm and risk models are largely retrospective and are not treated as live operational state.
Passenger and freight exposure, inspection evidence and safety culture are kept separate from raw incident counts.
MAIB annual statistics and individual investigation reports have different reporting periods and case-specific scope.
Marine safety recommendations and actions are not treated as universal vessel-risk rates or proof of complete risk closure.
Drone class-mark transition rules and airspace restrictions require current rechecking.
Built-in drone restriction data is not treated as authoritative when CAA warns it may be out of date.
The small-block fire guide is used only within its defined building scope.
The broader purpose-built-flats guide is explicitly marked as no longer comprehensive.
Stay-put assumptions are not applied unless building design and the current fire-risk assessment support them.
Work-at-height, electrical and confined-space controls describe activities and safe systems of work rather than land attributes.
Bathing-water annual classifications, daily warnings and pollution forecasts are kept as separate time scales.
Dynamic bathing-water warnings are rechecked and are not silently extrapolated to nearby parcels.
Transport, building, work-activity and bathing-water evidence is not converted into exact parcel-level probability.
Current official-source verification does not replace 130-candidate/16-endpoint live parity, browser DOM/console acceptance, commit ancestry, publisher push or remote readback.
No second runner was started; the stale single-runner recovery blocker remains OPEN.
